messages.攻撃加重値5で振動と沈潜をばらまく広域斬撃で、E.G.O。: A multi-target Slash E.G.O with 5 Attack Weight that spreads Tremor and Sinking.
messages.高火力の広域: 加重値5の2コインの広域。侵蝕スキルは敵味方を問わず狙うため、同: **High-damage multi-target**: A 2-Coin multi-target attack with 5 Attack Weight. The Corrosion skill targets friend and foe alike, so beware of friendly fire.
messages.振動と沈潜: Ⅰコインで振動5を付与して振動爆発、Ⅱコインで沈潜4を付与する。: **Tremor and Sinking**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 5 Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst, and Coin Ⅱ inflicts 4 Sinking.
messages.精神力の回復: 攻撃後に自分の体力が最大値なら、ターン終了時に精神力が10回復し: **SP recovery**: If his HP is full after the attack, he recovers 10 SP at Turn End (15 at Threadspin Ⅳ) and gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn. It does not work once his HP drops.
messages.精神力が低い敵への追撃(解析Ⅲ): 対象の精神力が0未満なら、不足ぶん1につきダ: **Follow-up against low-SP enemies (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: If the target's SP is below 0, +1% damage per point below 0 (up to 45%). It grows when Sinking drains SP.
messages.パッシブ「眠れぬ夜」: 戦闘開始時に、混乱・士気低下・パニックの敵の数だけ、全敵: **Passive — Insomniac Night**: At Combat Start, inflicts Offense Level or Defense Level Down on all enemies equal to the number of staggered, Low Morale, or panicking enemies (up to 2 times per turn).
messages.体力を保ったまま、複数の敵へ撃つ。: Fire it at multiple enemies while keeping his HP up.
messages.必要資源は怠惰2・暴食2・憂鬱2・傲慢2の計8個、精神消耗は20。: It requires 8 resources in total: 2 Sloth, 2 Gluttony, 2 Gloom, and 2 Pride, with a Sanity cost of 20.
messages.Ⅲ: 精神力が低い敵への追撃と、的中時の体力回復が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds the follow-up against low-SP enemies and HP recovery on hit.
messages.Ⅳ: 精神力の回復量が増え、混乱した敵などに属性脆弱が付く。: **Ⅳ**: Increases SP recovery, and staggered enemies and similar receive Sin Fragility.
messages.夜の錐カピターノ: 振動と出血を扱い、S1が怠惰、S3が傲慢で必要資源の一部を出: **[Night Awls Capitano](persona:1213)**: Uses Tremor and Bleed, and his S1 is Sloth and S3 Pride, supplying some of the required affinities.
messages.エドガー家 継承者: 沈潜を重ねて敵の精神力を下げられ、S2が憂鬱で資源も出せる: **[Edgar Family Heir](persona:1209)**: Can stack Sinking to lower enemy SP, and his Gloom S2 also supplies resources.
